name: Insulin
description: Guidelines for traveling with insulin in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Insulin is allowed in carry-on and is exempt from the 3-1-1 liquids rule as a medical necessity. Declare it to officers at security checkpoints.

checkedBag.reason: Insulin is allowed in checked baggage, but it should travel in the cabin because extreme cold in the cargo hold can freeze and ruin it.
